description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the domain layer of an ASP.NET Core application. It models an article with properties for ID, slug, title, description, body, author, comments, tags, favorites, and timestamps.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties such as title, body, author, comments, tags, and favorites, along with timestamps.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tag strings associated with the article.
